facts.text: Deborah expresses her willingness to support Jolene during challenging times.

evidence.quote: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you.

facts.text: Jolene acknowledges Deborah's support and mentions that she is working on a big project that has been both challenging and rewarding.

evidence.quote: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.
I've been working on a big project lately - it's been tough but also really cool to watch it take shape.

facts.text: Deborah encourages Jolene to make time for things that bring her joy.

evidence.quote: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy.
